body.statement: Non-novel sanity reduction: for every deterministic \(c\in\mathcal C\), evaluation of the uniform limits at \(c\) gives \(\sqrt n(\widehat\theta_c-\theta_c)\Rightarrow G_\theta(c)\) and \(nR_n(c)\Rightarrow\tfrac12G_\theta(c)^\top H_cG_\theta(c)\). Restrict FangRidderXie2026's admissible-rule framework to \(\{\pi_\theta:\theta\in\Theta\}\), set its optimization penalty to \(\lambda_{\mathrm{FRX}}=c\), and hence report \(c_{\mathrm{FRX}}=c/s_W^{\mathrm{FRX}}\). The optimizer conclusion reduces to its Theorem 5 and the quadratic-regret conclusion reduces to its Theorems 2 and 5.
body.justification: This is only a non-novel sanity reduction for auditing signs, Hessian normalization, and regret scaling against the published fixed-preference result.
body.gap: No independent gap is claimed: the statement is the deterministic-penalty specialization to FangRidderXie2026 Theorems 2 and 5 on the common regular softmax submodel under \(\lambda_{\mathrm{FRX}}=c\) and \(c_{\mathrm{FRX}}=c/s_W^{\mathrm{FRX}}\).
body.consumer: Readers can audit signs, Hessian normalization, and regret scaling against the published theorem before using the new simultaneous procedure.
